basic_info.description: 1 bedroom | 1 Office | 1 full bath | 1 parking | In-unit laundry.  Come visit this light-filled unit at the Oceanview Village! Built in 2002, this rare large 1-bedroom floor plan has an office, in-unit laundry and ample in-unit storage with 3 closets. New appliances, new paint, newer wood floors, granite countertop kitchen, and double paned windows, it is move in ready! Did I mention it also has a 1-car garage and ample guest parking? Within the complex features, Subway, Korean grocery H-Mart and food court. Walking distance to Daly City BART, Stonestown mall, SF State, many restaurants and shops.
